commercial-purchase.proves: A buyer can pay for the Studio tier with Stripe (test mode), comes back to the order page with a Commercial licence key, and finds it in Dashboard > Licences.

steps.text: Open the pricing page as a visitor
Signed out, so the button opens the hosted BuildBase sign-in page
Create a fresh test account (a +test address on the development environment)
Enter the verification code (test mode always accepts 424242)
Dismiss the optional prompt (passkey or two-factor offer)
Dismiss the optional prompt (passkey or two-factor offer)
Back on the store, signed in
Buy the Studio tier of the Commercial licence
Pay with the Stripe test card 4242 4242 4242 4242 (any future date, any CVC)
Paid: Stripe returns to the order page
The order page shows the Commercial licence key (masked here)
Dashboard > Licences lists the key, labelled Commercial

commercial-purchase.title: Buy a Commercial licence
